description: Java entity class representing localized descriptions for a category within the shopizer catalog service, mapping to the 'category_description' database table.

classes.name: CategoryDescription
classes.description: Entity class for category descriptions, including fields for ID, category reference, language ID, name, description, friendly URL, and timestamps.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the category description.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the UUID of the category description.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Associates this description with a Category.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Returns the UUID representing the language.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the localized name for the category.
